## Workflows

- [protocol-capability-modularization](../protocols/protocol-capability-modularization/SKILL.md): Catalogue functional capabilities, reuse shared foundations, and migrate vertical workflows in verified batches.
- [protocol-demonstrate](../protocols/protocol-demonstrate/SKILL.md): Turn a requested demonstration into observable requirements, a real user walk, and a reproducible handover.
- [protocol-document](../protocols/protocol-document/SKILL.md): Run an explicitly requested documentation sweep: inventory coverage, reverify claims, and fill gaps at their owning source.
- [protocol-garbage-collect](../protocols/protocol-garbage-collect/SKILL.md): Prove dead code and abandoned files unreachable in a named area before deleting the authorized set.
- [protocol-lean](../protocols/protocol-lean/SKILL.md): Survey repository weight across documentation, dependencies, code, CI and infrastructure; measure authorized cleanup.
- [protocol-regression-loop](../protocols/protocol-regression-loop/SKILL.md): Fix acceptance before editing, validate the actual changed artifact, and repeat focused checks until green or blocked.
- [protocol-restructure](../protocols/protocol-restructure/SKILL.md): Salvage a working legacy area, declare a target shape, migrate reversible batches, and verify before retiring the old tree.
- [protocol-template-app](../protocols/protocol-template-app/SKILL.md): Migrate a customer-specific application into a reusable accelerator, preserving approved public data and workflows while excluding private data, historical state and deployment identity.

MCP implementation: implemented; verification: offline-verified. Registrations: 0; disabled by default. With the selected installed `mcp` extra, explicitly run `agentcraft mcp --offline` for composition-only synthetic/offline stdio. No data, model, recovery or inventory binding is created. Other targets require a trusted host calling `agentcraft.mcp.create_server` with explicit bindings, exact per-binding tool grants, principal and execution context. Metadata is not activation, credentials, live-service evidence or installed-client acceptance.
